root_cause: lib/v04a_chain.py run_chain() gates corruption/restoration ONLY on spec.corrupt_hops / spec.restore_hops, never on the condition parameter. H-full and H-direct (pre-registered as zero-corruption) therefore received injected corruption and restoration at hops 3-5.

lib/v04a_worker.py LLMHandoffWorker.run() accumulates self.total_input_tokens/self.total_output_tokens but never sets self.last_usage. lib/v04a_chain.py reads getattr(worker, 'last_usage', {}) per hop -> always empty -> 40 real API calls reported as 0 tokens.
what_was_actually_wrong: Corruption propagation criterion and recovery criterion could NOT be honestly evaluated: corruption was applied to all conditions (F1) and chain-01 absorbs the +1 flip in one step (F4).
Token cost metric is unavailable (F2): 0 tokens reported despite 40 API calls.
Per-hop LLM records were not persisted (F3), so per-hop reporting is impossible post-hoc.

evidence.v04a_pilot_results.json: corruption_hops: 2 and restore_hops: 1 present in metrics of H-full AND H-direct; total_input_tokens: 0 across all conditions
evidence.lib/v04a_chain.py lines 235-242: if hop in spec.corrupt_hops: ... elif hop in spec.restore_hops: (no condition check)

outcome: 40/40 API calls succeeded, 0 errors. All conditions chain-survived with 0 divergence. Results are NOT valid for corruption/recovery evaluation due to F1+F4; token metric invalid due to F2.
recommendation: Recommendation B: fix corruption gating (condition-aware), set last_usage, persist HopRecords, optionally use multi-unit chain for pilot, then rerun 40-call pilot before the 4,000-call full experiment.
